channel.title: Brio
channel.description: Updates for Brio, the macOS menu-bar developer toolbox.

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.13
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.12

  • Keep the rulings made while building the Data tab verdicts
  • Record the Data tab verdicts in the feature map, status and open items
  • Keep the unavailable-simulator test independent of the size ceiling
  • Stop listing freshly erased simulators as reclaimable
  • Capture self weakly once in the runtime download task
  • Show deleted runtimes with Download and Forget
  • Keep xcodebuild's last line when the download is refused
  • Download a deleted runtime again with xcodebuild
  • Write deleted runtimes only when the list changes
  • Remember runtimes Brio deletes
  • Show the bulk delete's failure toast before waiting for runtimes
  • Wait for deleted runtimes to leave the list and report the space actually freed
  • Show every irreversible delete button in red
  • Show the bulk delete button in red
  • Lift the confirmation alert above the panel
  • Show each row's verdict and a Delete safe items button
  • Delete only the Safe items the confirmation listed
  • Add a Safe total and one delete for every Safe item
  • Refuse the delete fallback for an id that isn't a UUID
  • Delete a simulator simctl refuses by removing its folder first
  • Attach a safety verdict to every Data tab item
  • Add the Data tab's safety verdict rules
  • Plan the Data tab verdicts and amend the spec's rules
  • Add the Data tab verdicts, delete fallback and re-download spec
  • Trim the status to the shipped state of beta.12
  • Update the status for SF Symbols 27 and beta.12

item.title: 0.9.0-beta.12
item.description:
What changed since v0.9.0-beta.11

  • Fit the symbol detail to the panel and default to Bounce
  • Note the toast test's wall-clock race in the open items
  • Record the symbol detail row's parked items
  • Keep the symbol pickers honest and the typing rule testable
  • Describe the symbol detail row in the feature map
  • Open a symbol's detail under its line in the Symbols tab
  • Select, move between and filter symbols by release and keyword
  • Describe a symbol's modes, effects and code line for the detail row
  • Correct the plan's release count to 25
  • Carry each symbol's first release, layers and keywords
  • Plan the symbol detail row in four tasks
  • Spec the symbol detail that opens under its row
  • Regenerate the symbol catalog for SF Symbols 27
  • Record the parked list in docs/OPEN.md and update Current status
